text:
elaine: quick heads-up — landed intern PR #2143 and CI is failing linting. small renames + formatting. can someone take a 5-min look? @dmitri @ben

CI-bot: lint-check failed on branch feature/intern-2143 — pyproject black config mismatch (line-length 88 vs 100). see log: https://ci.example/12345

dmitri: on it. can you paste the failing file snippet?

elaine: sure — here's the snippet from tests/utils.py that flaked:
```python
def make_req(id, payload):
    req_id= id
    return {"id":req_id, "payload":payload}
```

alice: looks like two things: whitespace + variable name. repo style prefers `request_id` over `req_id` (history of telemetry naming). also we use black with line-length 100 in pyproject but pre-commit has 88, so ci runs 88.

ben: yeah — pre-commit vs CI mismatch. I hit this before when upgrading black. we should either pin black versions or update pre-commit. not for this PR though.

carmen: for this PR, simplest is to conform to current CI (88) and variable naming. add a tiny test fix.

elaine: ok will patch. two small questions: 1) prefer `request_id` everywhere? 2) should I run `pre-commit run --all-files` locally and push?

alice: 1) yes, `request_id`. 2) yep, run pre-commit and black locally (use the repo's pre-commit hook) then force-push. mention in PR description that you ran hooks.

dmitri: if you want I can push the quick rename/fmt commit to the branch to save time for the intern (they're offline).

elaine: would appreciate that! please keep the commit message clear — "style: rename req_id -> request_id and format per CI"

ben: small nit — prefer not to mix rename + formatting in one commit when possible, but given it's a tiny change i'm fine. add a short note in the PR about why they were combined. :thumbsup:

CI-bot: received new push (force-push) to feature/intern-2143 by dmitri — running checks...

dmitri: pushed the rename and ran pre-commit locally. PTAL.

CI-bot: all checks passed ✅ (lint, unit-tests, integration smoke).

ben: reviewed and left a minor comment about docstring wording, not blocking. approving now.

alice: approved. dm me if we need to revert.

elaine: thanks all! I'll merge in the next merge window (in ~30m) unless anyone objects. I'll also add a short note to onboarding checklist about running pre-commit hooks to avoid this next time.

carmen: no objections — good teaching moment for the intern. thanks @dmitri for stepping in.

elaine: merging now.

CI-bot: merged PR #2143 into main (by elaine). release-note: none.

elaine: updated onboarding doc: "run pre-commit hooks before pushing; if CI fails for black mismatch reach out to eng #eng for help"

ben: :tada: good shipper teamwork.

elaine: closing thread — thanks everyone!
